title: See a counter wrap
modelNote: This is a {width}-bit teaching model. The lesson uses {realWidth}-bit registers.
instruction: Choose Advance one tick. Each tick adds one. Watch which bits the counter stores.
initialNote: Starting reading: {start}. Choose Advance one tick to add one.
initialStatus: Starting reading: {stored}. No ticks have passed.

architectureNote: RISC-V has no carry or signed-overflow flag. The carry shown here belongs to the four-bit calculation.
